correctness.summary: The normalized diameter of the compact isoperimetric-minimizer fiber is upper semicontinuous by Niu's simultaneous metric-volume compactness theorem: diameter-realizing pairs subconverge to minimizers in the limiting fiber and symmetric-difference distances converge. Complementation gives symmetry, and the elementary 2 min(s,1-s) bound localizes multiplicity. Zero diameter is exactly uniqueness. Dense rational zeroes for Niu's generic metrics then make the zero set a dense G_delta and force every positive value to be a discontinuity. Strict-BV and half-volume modulo-complement collapse follow by the same compactness-plus-uniqueness argument.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: Niu states simultaneous uniqueness at rational fractions and generic uniqueness in the metric-volume pair space, but the inspected version does not state residual/comeager simultaneous uniqueness for one metric, the upper-semicontinuous multiplicity-diameter profile, the identification of nonuniqueness with its discontinuity set, the closed nowhere-dense quantitative multiplicity strata, or the strict-BV minimizer selection. Targeted literature and current SCOPE searches did not locate those statements. The main residual risk is that these are short structural consequences of a very recent preprint and may have been independently noticed or may appear in a later revision.

value.summary: The result upgrades a countable simultaneous generic statement to an uncountable comeagre set of volume fractions for a single generic metric and organizes every possible failure through a natural upper-semicontinuous multiplicity profile. It also supplies a strict-BV continuous minimizer spine on the uniqueness set and isolates the half-volume complement symmetry by a quotient-continuity statement, without requiring smooth minimizing boundaries.

limitations: Uniqueness is not proved for every real volume fraction.
The exceptional set may be an uncountable meagre F_sigma set; no measure, Hausdorff-dimension, porosity, or cardinality estimate is proved.
The residual-volume statement is a structural consequence of Niu's recent generic-uniqueness and compactness results rather than a new perturbative uniqueness proof.
The strict-BV continuity gives no differentiability, nesting, foliation, smooth dependence, or new boundary regularity.
The primary source is extremely recent, so a later revision or unindexed parallel note may contain the same Baire-category consequence.
Independent audit has not been performed.
